message.content:
This is a **digital infographic/resource guide** titled **"15 FREE WEBSITES FOR DOWNLOADING PHD THESES"** created by **Askpstudyinaustralia** (an educational resource platform for scholarships and academic success).

## Overall Layout & Design
- **Background**: Deep navy blue
- **Color scheme**: Navy blue, white, gold/yellow accents
- **Format**: Vertical list with numbered entries in a white rounded-rectangle container

## Header Section
- **Main title**: "15" (large gold numbers) + "FREE WEBSITES" (large white bold text)
- **Subtitle**: "FOR DOWNLOADING PHD THESES" ("PHD THESES" highlighted in gold)
- **Logo** (top right): Circular logo with graduation cap icon and "Askpstudyinaustralia" branding with tagline "SCHOLARSHIPS | RESOURCES | SUCCESS"

## Main Content: Numbered List (01-15)
Each entry follows this format:
**[Number badge]** | **Website Name** | **URL**

The 15 resources listed are:

1. **Open Access Theses and Dissertations** - https://oatd.org/
2. **Open Thesis** - http://www.openthesis.org/
3. **DART-Europe E-theses Portal** - https://www.ucl.ac.uk/library/
4. **ProQuest Dissertations & Theses** - https://www.proquest.com/
5. **MIT Theses** - https://dspace.mit.edu/handle/1721.1/7582
6. **Digital Library of Theses & Dissertations** - http://www.ndltd.org/
7. **Caltech Thesis** - https://thesis.library.caltech.edu/
8. **British Library EThOS** - https://www.bl.uk/
9. **Electronic Theses & Dissertation Centre** - https://etd.qiolink.edu/
10. **Harvard DASH** - https://dash.harvard.edu/
11. **Theses Canada Portal** - https://canadagtd.ca/
12. **RePEc (Research Papers in Economics)** - https://repec.org/
13. **SSRN eLibrary** - https://www.ssrn.com/
14. **Europe PMC** - https://europepmc.org/
15. **WorldCat Dissertations & Theses** - https://www.worldcat.org/

*Visual elements*: Each number is in a dark blue/gold rounded square; thin gold vertical separators between names and URLs.

## Footer/Call-to-Action Section
- **Banner**: Dark rounded rectangle with document/search icon
- **Headline**: "BOOST YOUR RESEARCH. SAVE TIME. ACCESS QUALITY KNOWLEDGE." (gold text)
- **Subtext**: "Explore these trusted platforms and advance your academic journey."
- **Website button**: Gold pill-shaped button with globe icon: **askpstudyinaustralia.com**

## UI Characteristics
This is a **static informational graphic** (not interactive software), designed for social media sharing or educational reference. It uses clear visual hierarchy, high contrast for readability, and structured data presentation to help researchers quickly identify and access thesis repositories.
